growth_signal.value: Named in VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026.

entry.idea: Shoppers rarely get rewarded for buying from their favourite brands, so Joko is an app that pays them cashback automatically.
entry.lesson: Make a saving happen automatically, so users do not have to do any work.
entry.name: Joko

growth.basis: substitute: named in VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026
growth.reason: No growth numbers in the sources.

market.reason: Shoppers and brands across Europe could use cashback.

tech.reason: A cashback app is useful but rivals can copy the idea within months.

sources.title: Paris-based fintech Joko raises 10 million euros

entry.twist: Rewards arrive on their own, with no codes or coupons to hunt for.
entry.who_pays: Brands and shops pay Joko when it sends them customers.
entry.why_now: Shoppers want savings, and Joko is aiming to grow into a wider shopping app.
